definitions: An area of ground for playing particular sports, such as football or rugby.
The quality of a sound governed by the rate of vibrations producing it; the highness or lowness of a tone.
A sticky, black substance used for waterproofing, made from tar or turpentine.
The level of intensity or degree of something.
A form of words used to persuade someone to buy or accept something.
The steepness of a slope, especially of a roof.
examples: The sales pitch was very convincing.
The roof has a steep pitch.
